```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.IESpace eSpace) => {
    
    /*** creating IClientAction 'ShowToast' ***/
    var showToast = eSpace.CreateClientAction("ShowToast");
    showToast.Description = "ShowToast (synthetic)";
    showToast.Public = false; // default value
    
    var startNode = showToast.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    var mOD_DEMO_Common_CW = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Common_CW");
    var showMessage2 = mOD_DEMO_Common_CW.ClientActions.Named("ShowMessage");
    var showMessage = showToast.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("ShowMessage");
    showMessage.Action = showMessage2;
    startNode.Target = showMessage;
    var endNode = showToast.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    showMessage.Target = endNode;
}
```
